description: Vendors that carry a peptide, tiered by PepEvolution COA audit status. `vendors` lists only vendors whose COAs are verified real, batch-matched, and from a named independent lab, ranked by Source Match (vendor grade × batch-COA freshness; ties resolve to the non-affiliate). `unaudited_vendors` publish COAs PepEvolution has not authenticated. Vendors with shared/recycled, fabricated, or no COAs are excluded and only counted. Strict name matching (e.g. BPC-157, TB-500, tirzepatide).

compound.description: Compound name, slug, or alias, e.g. "BPC-157", "tirzepatide", "NAD+"

name: find_peptide_sources
